snippet.title: Speakeasy Simulator Gameplay Trailer (Demo Nov. 1st)
snippet.description:
Wishlist and play our free demo on steam : https://store.steampowered.com/app/3883070/Speakeasy_Simulator/

Speakeasy Simulator is a simulation game crafted with passion which takes place during the Prohibition era in a fictional American city. Your goal will be to create your distillery, craft various spirits, decorate your bar, and satisfy your customers' needs. All of this of course while keeping your head low and not be spotted by law enforcements.
